title: Positive coefficient quotients have invertible exponent over the field
statement: Let F_q⊂k be the finite-field datum with algebraic closure k of characteristic p [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], l≠p a prime, E/Q_l finite and A=O_E/(ϖ_E^(n+1)) [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Then l^(n+1) annihilates A and is a unit in Γ(Spec k), i.e. A has invertible exponent on Spec k.

source.place: Paragraphs 2–3, lisse degree-zero specialization of the site-perfect stratum argument

proof.text: The extended absolute value of l is less than one, so l lies in the maximal ideal (ϖ_E) of O_E [lem-weil-l-adic-extension-integers-dvr]; hence l^(n+1)∈(ϖ_E^(n+1)) and l^(n+1)=0 in A.

source.place: Paragraphs 2–3, lisse degree-zero specialization of the site-perfect stratum argument

proof.text: F_q has characteristic p because its cardinality is a power of p, and k is an F_q-algebra, so char k=p≠l. Thus l≠0 in k, l^(n+1) is a unit of k, and its image under Γ(Spec k)≅k is a unit.
